title: bodhavilasa — bodh-p01-v09
question: Ever one, the established mind — by kalā, sattva, guṇa and the rest, by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). Ever one, the established mind — by kalā, sattva, guṇa and the rest, by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count.

premises.text: oṃ namo netrāya namaḥ śivāya satataṃ pañcakṛtyavidhāyine cidānandaghanasvātmaparamārthāvabhāsine citiḥ svatantrā viśvasya hetur ity abhidhīyate svātantryarūpā jñātā ca siddhīr vā saṃprayacchate sā svabhittau svecchayaiva viśvasyonmīlanāya ca nānānurūpavaicitryād grāhyagrāhakabhedataḥ viśvasya tasya vaicitryaṃ grāhyabhedena saṃsthitam nānāvaicitryayogena cottamādhamasaṅkhyayā citisaṅkocanāc cittaṃ cetano 'pi maheśvaraḥ vaṭadhanikāvat tatra viśvarūpaṃ ca tad viduḥ caitanyam ātmano rūpaṃ śuddham atyantanirmalam tad eva niyamāsaktaṃ cittaṃ cid abhidhīyate arthonmukhatayā saṃvic citte viśrāntim āgatā saṅkocātmapradhānatvāc citiś cittaṃ vidur budhāḥ māyāpramātā cidrūpas tanmayatvena dehinām vartate viṣayāsaktaḥ sadvivekavivarjitaḥ sadaikaḥ pratithaś cittaṃ kalāsattvaguṇādibhiḥ saptapramatṛkatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā ekaḥ sarvagataḥ śuddhaḥ sambodhātmā maheśvaraḥ saivāhantāparijñānān muktiḥ karatale sthitā
